fatal_blockers: The explicit dimension-9 top-Walsh candidate is dead: an unrestricted clause-drop selector has squared distance 105, below the required strict threshold 108. It cannot be promoted or reused without a mutation that charges deletion rather than merely charging parity.

The homogeneous clausewise fingerprint loses one unit of fingerprint energy when a clause is dropped while the anchor energy remains 72; only the normalization row charges the deletion. This directly defeats the claimed separation mechanism even though the seven-term parity attack rises to 153.

Nothing here establishes a uniform reduction, composition law, growing soundness gap, or dimension-dependent hardness. The n=9 calculation is finite evidence only and cannot support the target asymptotic theorem.

The proposed SDP is not yet evidence: a numerical optimum or separation of a preselected attack list would not certify unrestricted CVP soundness. Any survivor requires an exact rational certificate followed by unrestricted shell enumeration.
